source: due2-native: a policy-defined action with no odrl:includedIn (external review R07, #117)
notes: Not valid ODRL 2.2: an action other than odrl:use and odrl:transfer has exactly one odrl:includedIn, and the chain reaches one of the two (IM 2.4). Action matching reads the odrl:includedIn closure (due2-workflows.md §5.2), so without the edge a prohibition on odrl:use would not cover ex:frobnicate. Contrast due2-undeclared-action, where the action is not defined at all.

expected_rejection.why: ex:frobnicate has no odrl:includedIn (IM 2.4, decisions/0034). W1 rejects the policy in stage 1.
